finding: Finding where you are to verify it…
near: You are {dist} away: your report counts right away.
far: You are {dist} away: add a new photo so it counts now. Otherwise an admin confirms it.
noLocation: We could not tell where you are: add a new photo so it counts now. Otherwise an admin confirms it.
noLocationDenied: Location permission was not given: add a new photo so it counts now. Otherwise an admin confirms it.
photoFailed: We could not read that photo. Try another one.
videoFailed: We could not prepare that video. Try another or send a photo.
done: Thanks. It is in the history now.
donePending: Thanks. An admin reviews it, or another report confirms it.

error.rate_limited: You sent many reports in a row. Wait a while.
error.storage: We cannot store more videos right now. Send a photo.
error.turnstile: We could not verify you are a person. Try again.
error.server: Something failed on our side. Try again in a while.
